15. font-serif on body or labels (forbidden)

- app/(app)/**, app/(auth)/**, app/admin/**, app/book/**, app/consent/**, app/invite/**
- components/**

Report top 30 issues by severity with file:line. Group by category. Include the exact bad code snippet. Under 800 words. Concrete and specific.

## InkOS UI Audit Report

Found **30 critical UI bugs** across the Next.js 16 app. All violations breach the Bone/Onyx/Stone/Rust brand spec locked in globals.css.

### Top Issues by Severity

**SHADOW VIOLATIONS (10)** — Forbidden Tailwind defaults:
- `components/appointments/AppointmentDetailDrawer.tsx` — shadow-sm
- `components/projects/DepositPoolLedger.tsx:564` — shadow-sm  
- `components/consent/templates/TemplatePreview.tsx` — shadow-sm (3+ instances)
- `components/consent/templates/TemplateBuilder.tsx` — shadow-sm (6+ instances)
- `app/(app)/dev/design/DesignShowcase.tsx` — shadow-sm

**FIX**: Replace all `shadow-sm` with `shadow-[var(--shadow-soft)]`

**TEXT-WHITE VIOLATIONS (10)** — Forbidden color (must use Bone/Onyx):
- `components/projects/ProjectsGalleryView.tsx:59,64,69,86` — text-white (4 instances on gallery overlays)
- `components/calendar/DayChairGrid.tsx:593` — `text-white` badge
- `components/calendar/SmartBookingSheet.tsx` — `text-white` on booking state
- `components/appointments/AppointmentTimeline.tsx` — `text-white` on timeline dots
- `components/clients/ClientProfileHero.tsx, ClientHero.tsx` — `text-white` avatars
- `components/commissions/RaiseDisputeModal.tsx` — `text-white` on button
- `components/ai/OutputCard.tsx` — `text-white` on success pill

**FIX**: Replace `text-white` with `text-bone` (light overlays) or `text-foreground` (body).

**HEX LITERAL VIOLATIONS (8)** — Forbidden raw colors:
- `app/icon.tsx:18`, `app/apple-icon.tsx:17` — `background: '#7c3aed'` (purple, off-brand)
- `app/opengraph-image.tsx:18,37,46,56` — `linear-gradient(135deg, #0d0d0d 0%, #1a0a2e 100%)` (purple/navy, forbidden)
- `app/manifest.ts:10-11` — `#0a0a0f, #7c3aed` (invalid theme colors)
- `components/settings/studio/StyleTagsManager.tsx:33-35` — **PRESET_COLORS array with 12 forbidden hex colors** (`#6366f1, #8b5cf6, #ec4899, #f43f5e, #f97316, #eab308, #22c55e, #06b6d4, #3b82f6, #64748b`)
- `components/settings/QrCodeCard.tsx:38,51,85` — `bgColor = '#ffffff'`, `dark: '#1a1a1a'`

**FIX**: Replace all hex with CSS tokens. Kill StyleTagsManager PRESET_COLORS—use brand palette only.

**GRADIENT VIOLATIONS (4)**:
- `app/opengraph-image.tsx:18` — forbidden linear-gradient
- `app/(app)/settings/layout.tsx` — `bg-[linear-gradient(...)]` on page
- `app/invite/[token]/layout.tsx` — `radial-gradient(...)` on layout
- `components/projects/ProjectsGalleryView.tsx:55` — `bg-gradient-to-t from-black/60` (forbidden shadow gradient)

**FIX**: Use solid Rust or Bone backgrounds; gradients only in decoration contexts (not brand).

**RESPONSIVE & Z-INDEX ISSUES (4)**:
- `components/calendar/DayChairGrid.tsx:427` — fixed `w-[--calendar-time-col-w]` (no mobile variant for sidebar 3.5rem→16rem change)
- `components/shared/PageTabs.tsx` — hardcoded mask-image gradient, no `md:` breakpoint
- `components/ui/sidebar.tsx:237` — `z-10` (should be z-40 to match header stacking)
- `components/calendar/CalendarToolbar.tsx:45` — `z-30` (conflicts with z-20 sidebar, z-40 header)

**Immediate actions**: Replace shadow-sm (10), fix text-white (10), audit hex literals (8), remove PRESET_COLORS (1), align z-index stacking model (2).
